Component reference

variantcontinuous · vertical · branching
dataStage array, or nodes + links
texturemixed · hatch · stipple · cross · solid
densityPattern spacing in px · 3–14
curveRibbon curvature · 0.1–0.8
strokeWidthOutline weight in px
labelsShow direct annotations
onInspect / onSelectQuantity, source conversion, total

Branching charts accept directed acyclic graphs. Ribbon width represents quantity; omitted outgoing flow represents loss. Tracing highlights connected ancestry and descendants, not individual user journeys.
